accuracyFlags: FAQ lists only WA, Tasmania and parts of NT as charging vehicle entry separately, but the Alps and Blue Mountains guides (and NPWS, $17/$29 at Kosciuszko) show NSW also does; SA parks also charge entry at some parks. FAQ understates.
Parks Victoria figures are labelled 2025-27: the $6.60/$18/$32-$35/$43 amounts need re-checking against the current 2026-27 schedule.
Commercial powered-site range $39-$119 is built from two promotional offers (BIG4 Harrington, Sandstone Point), not a representative range.
Page headline is 2026 but the key government source is the 2025-27 schedule; add NPWS, Queensland, WA DBCA and Tas Parks fees.

Footer blurb says 'Find 74,000+ Australian places offline': AussieCamps is not an offline map; only place details and guides work offline, and the 74,000 total is out of scope but the wording should say 'place details and guides work offline'.
